test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) TC – AY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/624ebb2ddadf82f3a9559ff60f579d35b7e3521e3c389ac35572a18c01871bb4.png] 

Option 2) HQ – OL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7627c907884bdd417f1f0edbf3e6e0044e0d123b5f5b59e1d7d3f601fe87c85.png] 

Option 3) BK – IF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/682dfc924de261cfd538906854f09b4d3e012b455dde90d020a58b086f044fae.png] 

Option 4) PY – WT

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5659d1961ef96cdb91b2182e5b4a02c2aa96683e02bff4acdfb78fa615ba8a63.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'TC – AY' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

1b
